text:
Maya (People Ops): Heads-up: we've published an addendum to the vendor/contingent background-check section of the handbook. Key change: all third-party contractors who get network creds now require a Level-2 background check and a local compliance attestation. Please read and RSVP to the training if you manage vendors. Link: https://intra.redwood/workplace/handbook#vendor-bg

Jon (Hiring Ops): Thanks Maya — can you confirm the rollout date? Do we need to pause any existing contractor onboarding?

Maya (People Ops): Rollout date is next Monday (2026-04-06). No pause for already-onboarded vendors, but Hiring Ops must complete outstanding BG checks and update the vendor record in GreenHire by EOD Fri.

Aisha (Security): For clarity: Level-2 = SSN + employment verification + local criminal record check. If a region disallows SSN checks, use the regional attestation path in the doc. I've added a short checklist below that Hiring Ops should use.

people-ops-bot: Reminder set: vendor-bg-training 2026-04-07 10:00 PT — RSVP required.

Jon (Hiring Ops): Got it. Posting checklist for ops teams:
```
- Gather vendor legal name + DOB
- Request signed MSA if missing
- Initiate Level-2 BG check via CheckSafe portal
- If SSN not available, collect regional attestation form (see handbook)
- Update GreenHire vendor profile with BG status
- Notify manager + security when complete
```

Rosa (Legal): One note — for EU-based contractors, we need the DSGVO consent form attached to the background package. Maya, can you add a template?

Maya (People Ops): Yes, adding EU consent template to the handbook doc now. Will ping when done.

Liam (Eng Manager): Quick q: what about short-term vendor access (<7 days) for trade shows / conferences? Do they need Level-2?

Aisha (Security): Short-term access <7 days can use time-limited guest credentials + supervised access, no Level-2 required — but manager must submit a Guest Access Rationale in GreenHire and sign off.

Liam (Eng Manager): Great, thanks. I'll review the list of upcoming contractors and chase outstanding checks.

Jon (Hiring Ops): RSVP link for the training: https://meet.redwood/rooms/vendor-bg-training-0407 — added to calendar for ops + security + managers. Please mark "attending" if you'll be joining.

Maya (People Ops): I'll run a short Q&A during the session focused on edge cases (international contractors, student interns, vendor partners). Put any pre-questions here and we'll triage.

Liam (Eng Manager): Pre-question: how do we handle vendor employees that are on clients' payroll but need access?

Rosa (Legal): Usually we rely on client attestation + MSA clause. Bring the specific case to the Q&A and we can propose a wording update if needed.

Jon (Hiring Ops): Action items recap:
- Hiring Ops: run outstanding Level-2 checks, update GreenHire by Fri (assigned to Jon/team)
- People Ops: add EU consent template + handbook snippet (assigned to Maya)
- Security: prepare guest access SOP for <7 day cases (assigned to Aisha)
- Legal: review client-attestation clause for contractors (assigned to Rosa)

Maya (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll follow up with a short digest and a tracker spreadsheet after the training so we can confirm completion across teams. :thumbsup:

people-ops-bot: Thread pinned to #people-ops for 7 days.
